**Abstract.** We consider theS2×qS1 supersymmetric index of a 3dN = 2 theory T [M3] when M3 is a plumbed 3-manifold. We engineer an eﬀective description of T [M3] from the expression of the homological block for plumbed 3-manifolds as a D2×qS1 partition function of a 3d N = 2 theory T [M3] with a boundary condition. We check that the supersymmetric index for such a T [M3] is invariant under the 3d Kirby moves. arXiv:1912.13486v2 [hep-th] 22 Mar 2021
